heading: The C compiler is external
text:
## The C compiler is external [IAOT.4]

The DSC compiler invokes the system `cc` (or `DS_CC`) rather than
embedding a code generator, and the AOT pipeline is a post-emission pass
over the resolved program and the Rete network.

That is a choice of this implementation, not a property of DS, and it is
what makes the toolchain substitutable — a pipeline that shells out to a
compiler can shell out to a different one, which is what [IAOT.2.4]'s
gcc-or-clang requirement rests on. An embedded code generator could not
have carried that requirement at all.
